req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. The schema shows description is Optional[str] with default None in TaskBase/TaskCreate. Tests must cover: (1) positive — omitting description entirely yields HTTP 201 with description=null; (2) negative — omitting the required 'title' field yields HTTP 422; (3) boundary — description field present but explicitly null also yields HTTP 201; (4) boundary — description at max length (500 chars) with no description omission to contrast; (5) DT — all combinations of description presence/absence with completed flag. Assertions use exact status codes (201, 422) and exact JSON field values to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_without_description_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Task without description"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Task without description"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] == False

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_description_at_max_length_500():
    desc_500 = "x" * 500
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "BVA max desc", "description": desc_500})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["description"] == desc_500
    assert len(body["description"]) == 500

    desc_501 = "x" * 501
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "BVA over max desc", "description": desc_501})
    assert r2.status_code == 422
